title: Auditing evaluation artifacts and data leakage in large language model systems for rare disease diagnosis
reasons: 医学、生物医学或临床专题，超出当前 Agent 与通用模型评测方向
missingSignals: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
报告基线或多个模型的评测
材料中提供代码或数据链接（未核验内容）
给出任务规模或覆盖范围

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To address these systematic artifacts, we propose a rigorous evaluation framework - coupling strict data-isolation protocols with standardized benchmarking safeguards - to ensure future diagnostic AI for rare diseases is evaluated on actual clinical robustness.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Similar spatial overfitting in supervised classifiers caused diagnostic accuracy to drop from an internal mean of 42.9% to 16.7% across external cohorts (Cohen's d = 2.01).

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: A recent meta-analysis flagged augmented LLM diagnostic evaluations as having a high risk of bias due to suspected data leakage; however, the precise impact of these vulnerabilities on model inference has yet to be fully quantified.
